task_only_first_read.scope: Read only the two task.md files before recording the following assessments; prior shared context contains general benchmark goals but no R101/R102 reference or Lean source.

task_only_assessment.definitions: All structures, quantifiers, quotient spaces and normalization are specified. P is naturally a submodule and E a submodule of P; their well-definedness is a proof obligation rather than an extra assumption. No commutativity of R is needed.
task_only_assessment.shortest_valid_route: First solve the A/B congruences using x-y in A+B, take the residue of the difference from z modulo (A∩B)+C, prove independence of the two lifts and the Q representative, then prove exactness and identify each nonempty realization fibre as a coset of I. A standard non-distributive CRT obstruction formulation can compress this.
task_only_assessment.route_disclosure: The target explicitly supplies the obstruction module and normalization, which narrows discovery but is legitimate target data. It does not give the gluing construction or its well-definedness proof.
task_only_assessment.difficulty_limit: A knowledgeable author may give a short quotient/universal-property proof; no empirical difficulty inference is justified. The case tests illegal distributivity and representatives as much as chain length.

checks.evidence: Both prose and Lean quantify arbitrary Ring R, AddCommGroup M, Module R M and arbitrary Submodule A/B/C. No commutativity, field, finite generation, splitting or distributive-lattice hypothesis.

records is the actual compatible-triple submodule; noise identifies coordinate shifts in A/B/C. obstruction_image is exactly obstruction_space.map ambiguity.mkQ, matching H mapped into M/L, not all of M/L.

partial_exists derives a partial glue from x-y in A+B. partial_difference and obstruction_independent prove choice independence. raw_obstruction proves addition/scalar laws in the quotient, then noise_in_kernel and liftQ descend through Q; no assumption that Classical.choose is linear.

residue_kernel and residue_embedding_injective identify the actual diagonal quotient map. obstruction_zero_iff constructs a correction w-u for the converse. obstruction_onto_exact proves kernel=image; obstruction_surjective and obstruction_normalization prove the specified endpoint and sign.

same_record_iff matches actual quotient records with raw realizations. solution_fiber states s realizes iff s-t belongs to (A∩B)∩C, so the full original-space fibre is a coset and may have many elements.

The rational plane with coordinate axes and the diagonal has all pairwise sums M but nonzero obstruction M/C; (0,0,(1,0)) has no realization. A=B=M,C=0 gives nonunique partial glues but a unique obstruction class. A=B=C=M gives one quotient record with every element of M realizing it.

Required evidence matches the three task obligations. Counterexamples and author route are explicitly optional; no penalty for a legal short proof. Unsupported CRT/distributivity, wrong codomain and quotient/original uniqueness confusions are substantive errors.

task_only_assessment.definitions: The local finiteness is a finite set for each orbit, not a module or uniform exponent hypothesis. N_T/P_T, positivity of the period, requested uniqueness, decomposition, and intertwiner law are all specified.
task_only_assessment.shortest_valid_route: Finite orbit gives eventual periodicity for each x. Choose a period-multiple beyond the transient part to split x into locally nilpotent and periodic parts; show these are submodules with zero intersection. Uniqueness gives a linear idempotent projection and naturality; the periodic restriction is bijective.
task_only_assessment.route_disclosure: No intermediate period choice or Fitting route is supplied; all requested properties are natural structural endpoints of the projection.
task_only_assessment.difficulty_limit: An applicable local Fitting decomposition or elementwise polynomial Bezout argument gives a concise legal route. Reject unsupported uniform stabilization, not short valid proofs.

checks.evidence: PointwiseFiniteOrbit is literally forall x, Set.range(n ↦ (f^n)x).Finite, preserving the finite orbit SET hypothesis. No finite-dimensional span, uniform bound or pre-existing decomposition certificate appears.

nilpart and periodicpart directly use the stated existential powers, with p>0 explicitly included despite IsPeriodicPt itself allowing period zero. Common sums/products of exponents prove closure; nil_periodic_zero proves zero intersection including n=0.

finite_orbit_eventual invokes pigeonhole on the actual finite orbit subtype and obtains i<j. decomposition_exists uses k=np, proves k≥n and the required periodic/nilpotent membership from powers; no global stabilization is inferred.

decomposition_unique removes choices before projection add/scalar laws. projection_spec, kernel/range/idempotent theorems and projection_characterization give all projection claims. decomposition_equiv constructs the actual finite two-factor product equivalence with both inverse laws, matching a two-term direct sum.

periodic_restriction is an actual linear map. Injectivity uses the zero intersection; surjectivity sends each periodic x back by its own p−1. periodic_automorphism is a LinearEquiv.ofBijective, with no uniform period hypothesis.

semiconj_pow is derived from the actual pointwise intertwining relation. semiconj_nil and semiconj_periodic preserve both submodules; projection_natural then uses uniqueness. The second module is arbitrary over the same R and the intertwiner need not be injective/surjective.

Left shift on the direct sum over F2 is surjective and locally nilpotent, so intersection of all images is M while periodic part is zero, and no uniform nilpotence holds. Direct sum of r-cycles has every point periodic but no global positive period. Multiplication by 2 on Q has finite-dimensional orbit spans but infinite nonzero orbit sets. Swapping two basis vectors over F2 invalidates dividing by 2; over Q its cycle average projects to the diagonal rather than the entire periodic space.

Required projection/decomposition/automorphism/naturality obligations agree with the task. All legitimate short routes accepted; finite-length hypotheses, global exponents, averaging or a changed meaning of local finiteness are correctly treated as potential scope drift.
